## Company

- **Company:** Zen Mesh Inc., Toronto, Ontario, Canada.
- **Governing law:** Ontario, Canada.
- **Terms:** https://www.zen-mesh.io/commitments/legal/terms/
- **Privacy:** https://www.zen-mesh.io/commitments/legal/privacy/

## Pricing

- **Free Forever:** $0/month — 3 webhook endpoints, 25,000 webhooks/month.
- **Pro Early Bird:** $29/month (6-month free trial available).
- **Business:** Join waiting list.
